name: Acrobat's
rule: Falling damage after DR is halved; two Acrobat's pieces worn: no falling damage.

name: Assassin's
rule: +2 Physical and Energy DR against attacks by humans (Brotherhood of Steel, Survivor and Vault Dweller PCs, and Human characters that are not Mutated).

name: Auto Stim
rule: Once per scene, when HP drop below 1/4 of maximum, a carried Stimpak is used automatically without an action.

name: Bolstering
rule: +2 Physical and Energy DR on all locations below half maximum HP, +3 below 1/4.

name: Cavalier's
rule: Defending or sprinting gives +2 Physical DR on all locations until the start of the next turn.

name: Chameleon
rule: While hidden and not moving, tests to find the wearer get +1 difficulty.

name: Champion
rule: Once per scene, one d20 of a STR or END test counts as a 1 before rolling.

name: Cloaking
rule: Once per scene, being hit in melee makes the wearer invisible as with a Stealth Boy (CRB p. 171).

name: Cryogenic
rule: Enemy melee attacks have +1 complication range; on a complication the attacker takes Freeze Energy damage of as many CD as the attack would roll.

name: Cunning
rule: Once per scene, one d20 of a AGI or PER test counts as a 1 before rolling.

name: Duelist's
rule: Enemy melee attacks have +1 complication range; on a complication the attacker is disarmed.

name: Exterminator's
rule: +2 Physical and Energy DR against attacks by insects, arachnids and mirelurks.

name: Ghoul Slayer's
rule: +2 Physical, Energy and Radiation DR against attacks by ghouls.

name: Hunter's
rule: +2 Physical and Energy DR against attacks by mammals and lizards.

name: Incendiary
rule: Enemy melee attacks have +1 complication range; on a complication the attacker takes Persistent Energy damage of as many CD as the attack would roll.

name: Lucky
rule: Once per day, when spending Luck on a re-roll, a d20 counts as a 1 or the CD count as Effects instead of re-rolling.

name: Martyr's
rule: Below 1/4 of maximum HP, extra combat actions cost 1 AP less (does not stack with Jet and the like).

name: Mutant Slayer's
rule: +2 Physical and Energy DR against attacks by super mutants.

name: Poisoner's
rule: +4 Poison DR.

name: Powered
rule: In combat, 1 AP goes to the group pool at the start of each of the wearer's turns.

name: Punishing
rule: A melee attacker who hits takes 1 damage of the attack's type per Effect rolled, before DR.

name: Rad Powered
rule: Once per scene with radiation damage, one d20 of a STR test counts as a 1; once more per scene for every 5 radiation damage.

name: Safecracker's
rule: Once per scene, one d20 of a Lockpick test counts as a 1 before rolling.

name: Sentinel's
rule: +3 Physical and Energy DR if the wearer did not move last turn.

name: Sharp
rule: Once per scene, one d20 of a INT or CHA test counts as a 1 before rolling.

name: Sprinter's
rule: Crossing difficult terrain or obstacles costs 1 AP less (minimum 0).

name: Troubleshooter's
rule: +2 Physical and Energy DR against attacks by robots.

name: Unyielding
rule: Below 1/4 of maximum HP, re-roll 1d20 on any test.
